about: Forward Deployed Engineer at RLWRLD, turning teleoperation data into robot foundation-model training sets, and a Computer Engineering student at the University of Waterloo. I've built exoskeleton controllers and AprilTag tracking for robot-arm teleop in Tokyo, on-device AI for robots at hackathons, and production AI systems at a YC startup.

experience.description: Captures multi-modal teleoperation data (Quest 3, Vive, Manus gloves) into LeRobot datasets to fine-tune the RLDX-1 foundation model. Builds feasibility proofs-of-concept with the AWS Prototyping team, and mobile-base teleop, auto-homing and state recovery for robot controllers.
experience.summary: Teleop data (Quest 3, Vive, Manus gloves) into LeRobot datasets that fine-tune the RLDX-1 robot model.
experience.details:
RLWRLD builds RLDX-1, a foundation model for robots. As a Forward Deployed Engineer I work between the model, the robots and the customers who need them.

- Capture multi-modal teleoperation data with Quest 3, Vive and Manus gloves, and convert the sensor streams and tactile flags into LeRobot datasets that fine-tune RLDX-1 for specific tasks.
- Partner with the AWS Prototyping team to turn enterprise automation specs (heavy-load handling, stamping, pick-and-place) into live feasibility proofs-of-concept on two-week cycles.
- Upgraded the robot controller stack: mobile-base teleoperation controllers, auto-homing routines and state recovery, so live executive demos run without downtime.

experience.description: YC S24. Shipped Red Teaming, an adversarial voice-agent evaluation suite with an adaptive attack selector on Temporal workflows. Built a dual-mode in-app chatbot for navigation and root-cause analysis over call data.
experience.summary: Shipped an adaptive red-teaming eval suite for voice agents and an LLM root-cause chatbot.
experience.details:
Hamming (YC S24) tests and monitors AI voice agents.

- Shipped **Red Teaming**, an adversarial voice-agent evaluation suite: a three-axis attack matrix (category × technique × voice modification) with a UCB1/Bayesian selector that adaptively targets an agent's gaps, orchestrated on Temporal workflows.
- Designed a dual-mode in-app chatbot: a discovery agent for navigation and feature guidance, and a root-cause-analysis mode that uses LLM tool calls to pull filter-aware call data and answer with evidence and inline charts.
- Hardened transcript merging with provenance-aware source arbitration, turn-bounded alignment and similarity-based artifact filtering, plus an HTML diff harness that benchmarks pipeline regressions against production samples.

experience.description: Designed lightweight exoskeleton wrist controller with Dynamixel actuators. Built multi-camera AprilTag tracking system with 20% accuracy improvement. Developed interactive Three.js web interface for remote calibration.
experience.summary: <150 g exoskeleton wrist controller and AprilTag tracking (+20% accuracy) for robot-arm teleop.
experience.details:
A summer in Akihabara building teleoperation hardware and perception for robot-arm data collection. The full build is the **Robotic Arm Puppeteer** project.

- Designed a lightweight (<150 g) exoskeleton wrist controller in Fusion 360, with Dynamixel actuators for encoder feedback and haptic response, to teleoperate an 8-DOF Damiao arm for RL data collection.
- Built wrist-mounted magnetic AprilTag tracking with two cameras, Python and ROS 2 for real-time motion capture, improving tag recognition and bundle pose accuracy by 20% over the lab's existing setup.
- Wrote modular ROS 2 nodes that work across camera setups, and bridge nodes that map encoder readings to joint positions for inverse kinematics and TF in quaternion space, driving URDF simulators such as RViz2 and MuJoCo.
- Built an interactive Three.js calibration and visualization tool with Flask and Blender bone rigging.

experience.description: Designed and routed double-layer PCBs for controller subsystem. Maintained 0 ERC/DRC violations across all layers. Soldered and tested multiple SMD boards including IMU and power control circuits.
experience.summary: Double-layer PCBs for the solar car's controller; soldered and tested IMU and power boards.
experience.details:
Midnight Sun is the University of Waterloo's solar car team.

- Designed and routed double-layer PCBs for the car's controller subsystem in Altium Designer, with zero ERC/DRC violations across all layers.
- Soldered and tested SMD boards, including the IMU and power-control circuits.

experience.description: Developed and deployed client-facing e-commerce sites on Wix and Shopify. Reduced handover time with modular templates and simplified CMS workflows. Created cohesive brand identity with custom graphics.
experience.summary: Built client e-commerce sites and brand graphics.
